text: Seabrook Town regain possession deep in their own half on the left side through Aiden Quinlan, who intercepts the ball and quickly launches a long pass toward Kian Adeyemi near the halfway line. Adeyemi carries the ball forward along the left flank into the attacking third and passes short to Tariq Marlowe positioned centrally just outside the penalty area at Harbour City’s end. Marlowe sends a sharp through ball toward Callum Varga, who moves centrally about 9 metres from goal and confidently strikes the ball with his foot into the net, leveling the score at 2-2 in an open-play counter-attack [#1442] [#1443] [#1444] [#1445] [#1446] [#1448].
